mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.*, ROWNUM as rnum FROM ( SELECT fb.*, u.nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblQuestionAnswer WHERE question_board_id = fb.question_board_id) as commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblQuestionLike WHERE question_board_id = fb.question_board_id) as likeCount, qc.question_category_name FROM tblQuestionBoard fb INNER JOIN tblUser u ON fb.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN tblQuestionCategory qc ON fb.question_category_id = qc.question_category_id WHERE fb.question_board_status != 'n'
ORDER BY fb.question_board_id DESC ) a ) b WHERE b.rnum BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

choose.when: AND ( fb.question_board_title LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR fb.question_board_content LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblQuestionBoard fb INNER JOIN tblUser u ON fb.user_id = u.user_id WHERE (fb.question_board_status != 'n')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tblQuestionBoard ( question_board_id, user_id, question_board_title, question_board_content, question_board_status, question_category_id ) VALUES ( seq_question_board.NEXTVAL, #{user_id}, #{question_board_title}, #{question_board_content}, 'y', #{question_category_id} )
mapper.select: SELECT fb.*, u.nickname, qc.question_category_name FROM tblQuestionBoard fb INNER JOIN tblUser u ON fb.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN tblQuestionCategory qc ON fb.question_category_id = qc.question_category_id WHERE fb.question_board_id = #{_parameter}
mapper.update: UPDATE tblQuestionBoard SET question_board_view_count = question_board_view_count + 1 WHERE question_board_id = #{boardSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT keyword, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(fb.question_board_keyword, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) AS keyword FROM tblQuestionBoard fb WHERE fb.question_board_keyword IS NOT NULL AND fb.question_board_keyword != '' CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(fb.question_board_keyword, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL AND PRIOR fb.question_board_id = fb.question_board_id AND PRIOR SYS_GUID() IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT fc.question_answer_id AS question_answer_id, fc.question_board_id AS question_board_id, fc.user_id AS user_id, fc.question_answer_content AS question_answer_content, fc.question_answer_regdate AS question_answer_regdate, u.nickname AS nickname FROM tblQuestionAnswer fc INNER JOIN tblUser u ON fc.user_id = u.user_id WHERE fc.question_board_id = #{boardSeq} ORDER BY fc.question_answer_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tblQuestionAnswer (question_answer_id, question_board_id, user_id, question_answer_content, question_answer_regdate) VALUES (seq_question_answer.NEXTVAL, #{question_board_id}, #{user_id}, #{question_answer_content}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT question_category_id, question_category_name FROM tblQuestionCategory ORDER BY question_category_id
